problem_statement: Rebinding a UDP (datagram) socket fails. When a datagram socket has already been bound (so its connection is already registered to an interface and port), a second call to bind() on the same socket returns an error (EISCONN) instead of re-binding the socket to the new address/port. As a result, a program that binds a UDP socket, then re-binds it to a different local port and continues exchanging datagrams cannot succeed. Rebinding should succeed for datagram sockets; only stream sockets should still reject rebinding.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/socket/udp -s tests/net/socket/udp/net.socket.udp -s net.socket.udp -O twister-out --no-clean -W

verification.reason: The problem statement clearly describes the bug (EISCONN returned on rebinding datagram sockets), the desired behavior (rebinding should succeed for datagram sockets, only stream sockets should still reject rebinding), and the error code involved. The hidden tests check exactly this behavior by binding, re-binding to a new port, and exchanging datagrams. All names used by the tests (prepare_sock_udp_v4/v6, comm_sendto_recvfrom, MY_IPV4_ADDR, CLIENT_PORT, SERVER_PORT, etc.) already exist in the repository. The test refactoring (renaming, mutex→semaphore, setup consolidation) is test infrastructure unrelated to the fix and does not affect the agent's ability to write a correct solution.
